title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 3.11
exact_target: Find the sharp extrema ratio for homogeneous harmonic polynomials and the sharp growth comparison between negative and positive extrema for nonpolynomial harmonic functions, allowing an exceptional set of finite logarithmic measure.
